ios.desc:
HOW IT WORKS

1. Tell us your role and experience level
2. Review a curated list of interview questions for you
3. Practice the questions you are least prepared for.
4. Get real-time feedback on your answers and how to improve.

Echo is your interview companion who will take your results to the next level.

The reality is the most polished candidates get the best job offers. The best candidates show up rehearsed and nail the behavioral interview.

One mistake technical candidates make is disregarding the behavior interview sessions of their panels.

Practice makes perfect - Echo will guide you through the most common interview questions for all levels and skillsets, with a focus on the behavioral interview format.

Practice on our growing database of over 50 questions. Use Echo‘s AI assistant to record your answer, transcribe your answers to text, and receive feedback and a grade.

Mark your favorite questions and use the shuffle mode to practice a random question from your list.

Setup practice reminder notifications so you stay on top of your career search process.

Everything syncs automatically across your devices with iCloud.

quotes.text:
This is the first version of an app idea I had last month as a way to dip my toes into some of the AI APIs.

The idea is you can record yourself answering and rehearsing what you'll say to common interview questions, and receive AI feedback on how you did and how you can improve. In the future I may expand into other subject areas, but wanted to scope it to the behavioral interview format for the time being.

Super open to feedback and suggestions!
